Cosmetic improvements, painting, decorating, minor repairs do not qualify. Landlord must post permit application within 3 business days and secure permits before notice. Notice must include landlord's intent, description of work, expected duration/completion, permits or contractor contract, statement why work requires vacation, and notification of tenant's relocation rights. Amount: 2 months of actual rent for standard tenants, 3 months of actual rent for seniors (62+) or disabled tenants, calculated from rent under tenant's lease in effect at notice date. Landlord may elect to provide assistance by: (1) direct payment within 15 days of notice, or (2) rent waiver of equivalent amount through remainder of tenancy. For multiple tenants, single payment to all named tenants permitted. Relocation assistance is in addition to deposit/security return and credited against other relocation assistance under federal/state/local law. If tenant fails to vacate after notice expiration, actual relocation assistance provided may be recoverable by landlord as damages.","citation":"San Diego Municipal Code §98.0706(c)","quoted_span":"The landlord shall, regardless of the tenant's income or length of tenancy and at the landlord's option, provide relocation assistance to the tenant by one of the following: (A) The landlord shall provide a direct payment to the tenant.
